title: EnTrust: Modeling Inter-Modal Conflict for Trustworthy Multimodal Medical Image Analysis
authors: Dwarikanath Mahapatra, Abhijit Das, Behzad Bozorgtabar, Zongyuan Ge, Sudipta Roy, Deepak Nayak, Mauricio Reyes, Imran Razzak
summary: EnTrust separates shared anatomy, modality-specific cues, and inter-modal conflict. A diffusion-based segmentation model uses these signals to express uncertainty where imaging modalities disagree.

visualization.label: Modality disagreement
visualization.description: Two modality surfaces separate around a shared structure, making disagreement visible.

title: PROTON: Prototype-Based Test-Time Online OOD Detection for Medical VLMs
authors: Abhijit Das, Nichula Wasalathilaka, Yifan Lu, Adinath Dukre, Dwarikanath Mahapatra, Shadab Khan, Imran Razzak
summary: PROTON maintains an online prototype bank from high-confidence test predictions and combines prototype distance with concept-matching scores to detect distribution shifts.

visualization.label: Prototype distance
visualization.description: A moving query is compared with clusters and their prototype centers.

title: Graph-of-Differences: Anatomy-Structured Difference Alignment for Medical Image Re-Identification
authors: Nichula Wasalathilaka, Abhijit Das, Imran Razzak, Dwarikanath Mahapatra

visualization.label: Anatomy correspondence
visualization.description: Two graphs align corresponding nodes across separate observations.

summary: Graph-of-Differences represents images as graphs of named anatomical regions, matches corresponding nodes, and aligns anatomy-level differences with the global image representation.

title: Weight-Decay Turns Transformer Loss Landscapes Villani: Functional-Analytic Foundations for Optimization and Generalization

visualization.label: Regularized loss geometry

summary: A functional-analytic study of Transformer objectives with weight decay, investigating coercive loss geometry, convergence of noisy optimization, and generalization bounds.
